description: Contrast ratio for every pair of 2 to 12 colors (up to 66 pairs), highest first, each flagged against the chosen WCAG level. Use it to see which brand colors can be used together for text. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/palette.

items.description: Palette color as a CSS color: "#1a73e8", "#fff", "rgb(26 115 232)", "hsl(217 80% 51%)", "rgba(0,0,0,.6)" or a name like "navy".

level.description: WCAG target: aa 4.5:1 (default), aa-large 3:1, aaa 7:1, aaa-large 4.5:1, ui 3:1 (non-text).

name: check_palette
title: Check every pair in a palette
